Summarize a fitted curequantile object

Source: R/summary.R
summary.curequantile.Rd

This function returns the parameter estimates, bootstrap standard errors, Z-test statistics, p-values, and bootstrap confidence intervals for both the incidence covariates and the latency covariates at the specified quantile, tau.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'curequantile'
summary(
  object,
  b = 200,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  tau = 0.5,
  large = 10000,
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

an object of class curequantile.

b

number of bootstrap replicated for standard error estimation. Default is b = 200.

probs

percentiles for a bootstrap confidence interval. Default is c(0.025,0.975).

tau

quantile at which latency parameters are to be estimated.

large

a large positive constant at which to set censored times.

seed

optional random seed to promote reproducibility.

...

optional arguments.

Value

A list with the following components:

gamma_hat

a matrix that includes the parameter estimates, bootstrap standard error estimates, Z-test, p-value, and bootstrap confidence interval for incidence covariates.

beta_hat

a matrix that includes the parameter estimates, bootstrap standard error estimates, Z-test, p-value, and bootstrap confidence interval for latency covariates at the user-supplied quantile tau.

tau

user-specified quantile.

b

number of bootstrap resamples used in estimating standard error.

Examples

library(survival)
fit_breast <- curequantile(Surv(log(Time), Delta) ~ Size,
    data = breast_data, subset = 1:200)
summary <- summary(fit_breast, tau = 0.50, b = 10)
#> Warning: number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length
